title: Assessment of Enabling Factors: Central African Republic
publisher: Global Partnership for Education, Independent Technical Advisory Panel
why_not: Describes only the census and yearbooks (aggregate data by sex, level, school type, inspectorate) and EduTrac as SMS reports from schools to a web platform since 2019; no learner record, no statement that records are on paper, and its donor-dependence finding is outside the 36-month window.
